parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch part of the wall switch assembly, made of durable ABS plastic. It is a small rectangular lever that can be toggled up or down.
parts.Functional_description: The switch serves as the user interface for controlling the electrical circuit, allowing current to flow or stop when toggled.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a hinge mechanism to change its position between ON and OFF states.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the switch mechanism securely and mounts onto the wall, ensuring electrical insulation and mechanical stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
